lighter_prose.passage: The template landed at `1f7116b4`: one `Algorithm.h` and a numpy sketch become a JUCE 8 VST3/AU, with a harness, a host check that compares every move against a control render from the same start, and `new-plugin.py`. Two plugins came out of it the same day ... One gotcha arrived from outside: the [[Ableton Session Writer]]'s probe found Frustration's VST3 sealed before JUCE wrote its `moduleinfo.json`, so Live refused it; the VST session re-signed it after the manifest step, and the Set loaded in Live 12.4.6 on 2026-10-21. Sign after the manifest, then let Live rescan.
lighter_prose.words: One `Algorithm.h` and a numpy sketch become a JUCE 8 VST3/AU, with a harness and a host check against a control render. Two plugins came out of it, Frustration and Simple Synth, and both pass pluginval at strictness 5, auval and the host check. Sign the VST3 after JUCE writes its `moduleinfo.json`, or Live will refuse it; the [[Ableton Session Writer]]'s probe found this. (The commit hash and the day-by-day telling are in git log.)

summary: I read the five newcomers whole (or the first nine thousand characters for the three longest), plus Splice Instrument Forge, Generative Audio Devices, Maker, The Shop, Radio Play, Haptic Handwheel, Project Stewardship System, the three stewarded projects and their scrolls, and grepped the rest of the two-hop ring. The pattern: every newcomer was written with its links pointing outward to the Shop, Maker and the tools it couples with, and the pairs on the other side are already filled or have nothing to say, so a reverse link would double a pair. The one place with real unlinked traffic is the VST Template: the nine VST-path stewards name it as their production path, and Crystal Synthesizer and Bayesian Granular Synthesizer have already built or dressed through it, so I propose three inbound links (Project Stewardship System, Crystal Synthesizer, Bayesian Granular Synthesizer), each connects-to with a label. For Ableton Session Writer, AuK, CAD Drafter and LDN RTM I propose none; the gaps are single sentences on Haptic Handwheel, Kokoro and Maker, listed in the health flags. Weak links: none met bare. Not settled: whether Blood Compressor (plugin folder exists, template build not yet run from it) and the six other stewards should take the same link now or when each has a plugin built; I held them back so the link arrives with its proof. Also not settled: whether the stewards' entry pages should take a body sentence before the typed link lands, since the scrolls carry the reason and the entries do not.
